tokens.name: brand-500

tokens.name: brand-600
tokens.usage: Primary button and selected-tab background. Pairs with on-brand text (5.2:1 light, 7.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: brand-700
tokens.usage: Primary button hover / pressed.

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: Orange text: links, active nav label, KPI accents. 5.3:1 on surface-000.

tokens.name: brand-50
tokens.usage: Faint orange wash behind the topbar environment badge and empty states.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand-600.

tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Page and card background. White is the dominant surface of the console.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Sidebar, table headers, Kanban column ground.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Hover rows, input wells, chart track.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on any surface (17:1 light).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, axis labels, metadata. 6:1 on surface-000, 5.6:1 on surface-100.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Card outlines, dividers, table rules.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input and secondary-button borders (3:1 control contrast).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring on every interactive element.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Status: link UP, ping PASS, Resolved. Always with a dot or icon and a label.

tokens.name: good-bg
tokens.usage: Ground behind good status pills.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Status: SLA at risk (under 25% left), degraded. Yellow-amber, kept apart from brand orange by lightness; never without a label.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Ground behind warning pills.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Status: link DOWN, SLA overdue, Needs Human Review.

tokens.name: critical-bg
tokens.usage: Ground behind critical pills and overdue KPI cards.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Status: AI action in progress, 4G backup detected, informational events.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Ground behind info pills.

tokens.name: term-bg
tokens.usage: Raw ping / traceroute log and JSON blocks. Dark in both themes; in dark it sits a step below surface-000 with a border.

tokens.name: term-ink
tokens.usage: Text on term-bg (16:1).
